en.title: Balancing Parentheses by Moving at Most One
en.description:
For each string, you may take at most one parenthesis out of its position and insert it at any position; determine whether the string can become an ordinary valid parenthesis string. Not moving anything is allowed. Output 1 or 0.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of parenthesis strings. 1≤n≤200000, each string has length 1..200000, the total length is ≤200000, and only left and right parentheses appear.
en.output: Output n values, each 0 or 1, in the same order as the input strings.
hints: Compute the total balance and the minimum prefix balance; the total balance must be 0, and it suffices that the minimum is not less than −1.
